cs.t: Same here, N150, no issues. Don't think I've made any changes to the BIOS. Fans spin a lot near-constantly though, I think it is the on board M.2 SSD that is hot, I need to get around to adding a thermal pad or something one of these days.

Just another data point, I got a Beelink S13 Pro N150 running similar things as OP and haven't had any issues. I made changes in BIOS (set "Chipset > PCH-IO > State After G3" to S0 so it boots up again after regaining power) and they are sticking for me.
